0022600162.text: The Wizards (3-3, W1, 6th in the East, 1st in the Southeast) visit the Orlando Magic (2-4, L1, 9th in the East, 5th in the Southeast, 1 game back), with Washington 1-2 on the road and Orlando 0-3 at home. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve), and Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Orlando is without Anthony Black (out, rest), Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and the teams have no games yet this season, while in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 1-3 in the season series, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
